verses.text: YHWH reigns, let the peoples tremble! He dwells [above] the cherubim, let the earth be shaken!

segments.text: YHWH reigns, let the peoples tremble! He dwells [above] the cherubim, let the earth be shaken!

verses.text: YHWH [is] great in Zion, and high [is] He over all the peoples.

segments.text: YHWH [is] great in Zion, and high [is] He over all the peoples.

verses.text: Let them praise Your great and awesome name! Holy [is] He!

segments.text: Let them praise Your great and awesome name! Holy [is] He!

verses.text: The mighty King loves justice, You have established uprightness; justice and righteousness You have done in Jacob.

segments.text: The mighty King loves justice, You have established uprightness; justice and righteousness You have done in Jacob.

verses.text: Exalt YHWH, our God, and bow down at His footstool! Holy [is] He!

segments.text: Exalt YHWH, our God, and bow down at His footstool! Holy [is] He!

verses.text: Moses and Aaron [were] among His priests, and Samuel among those calling on His name—they called to YHWH, and He answered them.

segments.text: Moses and Aaron [were] among His priests, and Samuel among those calling on His name—they called to YHWH, and He answered them.

verses.text: Within the pillar of cloud He spoke to them; they kept His testimonies, and the statute He gave to them.

segments.text: Within the pillar of cloud He spoke to them; they kept His testimonies, and the statute He gave to them.

verses.text: O YHWH our God, You answered them; a forgiving God You became for them, and one taking vengeance over their misdeeds.

segments.text: O YHWH our God, You answered them; a forgiving God You became for them, and one taking vengeance over their misdeeds.

verses.text: Exalt YHWH, our God, and bow down at the mountain of His holiness—for holy [is] YHWH our God!

segments.text: Exalt YHWH, our God, and bow down at the mountain of His holiness—for holy [is] YHWH our God!
